brief: #197 gave the beds a weed CA over `rank[]` and put a hoe rung FIRST in `plotAct` — but nothing steers the crew toward a plot that has gone over. `rank` does not enter `sendToPlot`'s target set, so the hoe fires only when a picker happens to land on that plot: 20 times in 6 seed-years (c291). A CA that grows and a crew that cannot see it is half a system. Make the allotments answer their own weeds — the plot that has gone over should be the plot somebody walks to.
successLooksLike: A plot left to go over draws somebody to it: hoe events per seed-year rise well clear of 20, and a summer walk past the allotments finds a kneeling figure in the weediest bed rather than a random one.
avoid: Do not starve the harvest to feed the hoe — measure picked cells per year on both sides of the change. LAWS: a ladder's lower rungs are bounded by its FIRST rung's hit rate, and a rung nothing steers toward fires only when the crew happens to reach it.
